_note: v2.8 plan 47 (no-model lane, seeded: the reads are debug responses, so this is plumbing for the read and live for acceptance, store, Overview and rollback): the player's exact words to Arin become an open promise listed on the player Overview (#so-player-promises); a later read closes it as kept on Arin's reply, so it leaves the list; a swipe of that reply reopens it on the Overview; a reopen of the chat keeps it open. assert-player-clean in player mode. Run: node scripts/debug/so-scenario.mts run test/scenarios/v28-47-promises.json --sandbox --group 'Group: Arin, DM Narrator', twice.

steps.eval: for (const key of Object.keys(globalThis).filter((k) => k.startsWith('storyOrchestratorDebug'))) delete globalThis[key]; globalThis.storyOrchestratorDebugExtractionResponse = 'SCENE_NONE'; const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); for (let id = ctx.chat.length - 1; id >= 0; id -= 1) await ctx.deleteMessage(id, undefined, false); return { cleared: ctx.chat.length === 0 };

import_story.title: SO-V28-47 Promises
import_story.description: Plan 47 no-model fixture: a promise to Arin, kept, then rolled back by a swipe.

steps.eval: const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; rt.setUiSettings({ authorView: true }); rt.setExtractionSettings({ cadence: 0, stabilityLag: 0 }); if (rt.getGlobalSettings().memory.promises === false) throw new Error('memory.promises is off on this install'); const pause = (ms) => new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, ms)); const until = async (test, ms, what) => { const end = Date.now() + ms; for (;;) { const value = await test(); if (value) return value; if (Date.now() > end) throw new Error('timed out after ' + ms + ' ms: ' + what); await pause(200); } }; const QUOTE = 'I promise I will bring your lantern back before dawn'; const open = () => rt.getSnapshot().promises ?? []; const overview = async () => { const modal = document.querySelector('#so-workspace-modal'); return modal?.querySelector('#so-player-promises')?.textContent ?? ''; }; const NL = String.fromCharCode(10); globalThis.__p47 = { pause, until, QUOTE, open, overview, NL }; return { ok: true };

steps.send: Arin, I promise I will bring your lantern back before dawn.

steps.eval: const p = globalThis.__p47; const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); const m = ctx.chat.length - 1; if (!ctx.chat[m].is_user) throw new Error('the promise line is not the player message'); await rt.runExtractionNow('[promised] Arin | m=' + m + ' | "' + p.QUOTE + '"' + p.NL + 'NO_DELTA', 'manual', { from: 0, to: m }); const rows = await p.until(() => p.open().length ? p.open() : null, 10000, 'the promise to be stored'); if (rows.length !== 1 || rows[0].quote !== p.QUOTE) throw new Error('unexpected promise rows: ' + JSON.stringify(rows)); p.id = rows[0].id; p.m = m; return { id: p.id, promisee: rows[0].promisee, quote: rows[0].quote };
globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime.setUiSettings({ authorView: false }); await globalThis.__p47.pause(800); return true;

const p = globalThis.__p47; const text = await p.until(async () => { const t = await p.overview(); return t.includes(p.QUOTE) ? t : null; }, 10000, 'the promise on the player Overview'); if (!text.includes('Arin')) throw new Error('the Overview promise does not name Arin: ' + text); if (text.includes(p.id)) throw new Error('the promise id reached the Overview'); return { overview: text.slice(0, 200) };
document.querySelector('#so-workspace-modal')?.close(); globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime.setUiSettings({ authorView: true }); await globalThis.__p47.pause(500); return true;

steps.slash: /sendas name=Arin Arin takes the lantern back from you and smiles.

steps.eval: const p = globalThis.__p47; const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); const k = ctx.chat.length - 1; if (ctx.chat[k].is_user) throw new Error('the keeping message is not a reply'); await rt.runExtractionNow('[kept] ' + p.id + ' | m=' + k + ' | "Arin takes the lantern back from you"' + p.NL + 'NO_DELTA', 'manual', { from: p.m, to: k }); await p.until(() => p.open().length === 0, 10000, 'the kept promise to leave the open list'); p.k = k; return { kept: p.id, at: k };
globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime.setUiSettings({ authorView: false }); await globalThis.__p47.pause(800); return true;

const p = globalThis.__p47; await p.pause(800); const text = await p.overview(); if (text.includes(p.QUOTE)) throw new Error('the kept promise is still on the Overview'); return { overviewAfterKept: text.slice(0, 120) };

document.querySelector('#so-workspace-modal')?.close(); globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime.setUiSettings({ authorView: true }); const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); const last = ctx.chat.length - 1; if (last !== globalThis.__p47.k) throw new Error('a message landed after the keeping reply'); const reply = ctx.chat[last]; reply.swipes = [reply.mes, 'Arin shrugs and says the lantern can wait until morning.']; reply.swipe_id = 0; reply.swipe_info = [{}, {}]; await ctx.saveChat(); return { swipeable: last };
